sar_narrative: On 2026-04-10 through 2026-04-17, the account SYN_d71b5fb9, a retired individual with an expected monthly volume of $1,313, executed four wire transfers to a newly‑added payee, Elizabeth Taylor, in amounts of $1,864.81, $4,568.71, $19,601.33 and $17,791.43, totaling $43,826.28. This represents a vs_declared_volume_ratio of approximately 33.4, far exceeding the reported 19.18, indicating a sharp surge. The activity shows a single counterparty concentration and a velocity spike, consistent with layering behavior. Upon verification, the auxiliary numeric finding of $25,186.28 appears inconsistent with the computed total; the correct total is $43,826.28. The pattern warrants a SAR. Refer the case to the compliance team for further investigation.
